scripts.dev: concurrently -n relay,shelter,transit,supply "npm run dev -w @relay/command" "npm run dev -w @relay/shelter-grid" "npm run dev -w @relay/transit-ops" "npm run dev -w @relay/supply-hub"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @relay/command && npm run build -w @relay/shelter-grid && npm run build -w @relay/transit-ops && npm run build -w @relay/supply-hub
scripts.verify: npm run check:origin-isolation && npm run typecheck && npm run smoke && npm run audit:release && npm test && npm run build
